description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the SLAP Access Manager component, including function pointer types, object structure, and associated constants. It sets up the framework for object access management within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP).

classes.name: SLAP_ACCESS_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: Data structure representing the SLAP Access Manager Object, encapsulating properties, interface handles, and function pointers for managing SLAP object access.

methods.name: ResetProperty
methods.description: Resets the properties of the SLAP Access Manager to defaults.

methods.name: Reset

methods.name: Engage
methods.description: Activates or engages the SLAP Access Manager.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Deactivates or cancels the SLAP Access Manager.
